# Honora Hollis

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)</sub>
- **Rank:** Sophomore  <sub>[v3 c16 P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v2 c16 P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is a tall, fair, and blonde young woman who possesses an ethereal, golden beauty. She exceeds the majority of her peers in height by two inches.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_

## Personality

Though appearing contemplative and ethereal, Honora is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She has a lively, humorous conversational style and can act dreamy at times. She is also thoughtful, comforting, and supportive toward her friends during moments of anxiety or self-doubt.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v3 c3 P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006)_

## History

Honora attended Regent's Academy, where she formed close friendships with Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby. She gave presentations for the Brierley Village Improvement Society, including one on graveyards. After teaching at Delford and later her home school, she gained her father's permission to attend Wexcombe College, rooming with Nell. Alongside Nell, Mabel, and Cressy Lindsay, she resided at Tabby's Place under the housekeeping care of Aunt Euphemia. Upon graduating with Honors in Classics, she married a handsome foreign missionary and relocated to Japan.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_

> It would be my desire to achieve fame  <sub>[v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034)</sub>
